note: Known release limitations. The release gate passes only when every UNIMPLEMENTED rule listed here has approved=true, set by the release owner (not by the build). An approved rule is still never executed: it is shown as 'APPROVED LIMITATION / NOT EXECUTED' and is never reported as an MCA validation PASS.

limitations.description: Mandatory Line Items row 20 (complete V1.3 workbook, identical text in both ML sheets), clause 'In OutstandingBalancesForRelatedPartyTransactionsAbstract- Element for amount shall be mandatory for various transactions' does not identify which amount elements are required; the 'Specific rules for elements' sheet has no rule text for OutstandingBalancesForRelatedPartyTransactionsAbstract (row 2118). Needs MCA clarification.
evidence: MCA-validated reference instances (34 related-party rows): no outstanding-balance amount (AmountsPayable/AmountsReceivable/ProvisionsForDoubtfulDebts/ShareApplicationMoney/MaximumAmount…) in any row — MCA's validator does not require one per row.
limitations.recommendation: Approve as a documented limitation (approved=true, approvedBy=<release owner>) or obtain MCA clarification. Any executable reading that requires an outstanding-balance amount would reject both MCA-validated instances.
